_comment: Exit thresholds — REQUIRED, fill these in before first run. No hardcoded fallback is used for these on purpose (a wrong silent default could mean no stop-loss).
_comment0: takeProfitPct is OPTIONAL — null disables instant take-profit. Set it via the Telegram bot's Settings button, or here.
_comment0b: stopLossRequireOorLeft: when true, stop loss only fires if the position has ALSO broken out of range to the downside (OOR kiri). Optional, defaults to false. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment0h: trailingFastDropMultiplier: if the drop from peak is at least this many times trailingDropPct, TRAILING_TP fires immediately (skips confirmTicks) instead of waiting for consecutive confirmation — a drop that large during a fast crash isn't the one-tick noise confirmTicks exists to filter, and waiting just lets a fast-moving memecoin fall further before the close executes. Optional, defaults to 3. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment0e: outOfRangeExitEnabled: on/off switch for the out-of-range exit below. Optional, defaults to true. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment0f: outOfRangeRequireLeft: when true, the OOR-wait exit only fires on a sustained break to the downside ('OOR kiri'), not a bullish breakout to the upside. Optional, defaults to false. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment0g: lowYieldExitEnabled: on/off switch for the low-yield exit below. Optional, defaults to true. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment0c: Strategi Dual Side: exit rules khusus posisi dual-sided (liquidity di token X & Y sekaligus), terpisah dari TP/SL biasa di atas. dualSideStopLossMode: 'pnl_and_oor' (SL butuh PnL tembus SL% DAN oor kiri), 'oor_only' (SL langsung fire begitu oor kiri, PnL diabaikan), 'pnl_only' (SL fire dari PnL aja, oor diabaikan). Optional block, all default to off/null. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment0d: Trailing TP khusus Dual Side — terpisah dari trailingTakeProfit biasa di atas, jadi posisi dual-side bisa punya trigger/drop sendiri. Optional, defaults to off/null. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment1: How long (seconds) to suppress take-profit/stop-loss/trailing-TP checks after a position is first seen, since Meteora's indexer can briefly report a stale ~-100% PnL right after open. Optional, defaults to 20.
_comment1b: Extra safety net on top of exitGracePeriodSec: after a size top-up, keep suppressing exit/peak checks until reported PnL drops back within topupSettleTolerancePct of its pre-top-up value for topupSettleConfirmTicks consecutive polls (and at least topupSettleMinSec has elapsed), for up to topupMaxSettleSec before giving up and trusting the reading anyway. The min-time + consecutive-poll requirement matters: a single early reading can look 'settled' by coincidence (often right at 0% baseline) before the indexer's phantom-profit spike has even shown up, which used to clear this guard too soon. Optional, defaults shown below.
_comment2: Operational parameters — have sane defaults, override if you want.
_comment4: Jito anti-MEV: uses Jito's official DontFront technique (solana.com/docs/defi/mev-protection) — a marker account added to the transaction so the Jito block engine guarantees no other tx can be placed ahead of it, sent via sendTransaction (not sendBundle, which failed 9/9 in earlier testing). Optionally still attaches a tip for faster landing. Only affects close transactions, not the post-close auto-swap. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment5: Range-consumed alerts: informational only (never closes a position) — notifies when a single-sided position's active bin has moved this % of the way through its range toward the far edge, i.e. how much SOL looks converted into the base token so far. Computed from bin data already fetched every tick, no extra RPC calls. Optional, default on. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment6: Bin yield guard: flags a position that's consumed a lot of its range (binYieldGuardBinPct) without earning fees to show for it (fee/TVL24h below binYieldGuardMinFeePerTvl24h) — sign the deposit may be heading into a low-liquidity/rug-risk zone rather than a healthy range walk. binYieldGuardAction 'notify' (default) sends a Telegram alert only; 'close' wires it into the normal exit pipeline (still confirmTicks-gated) to auto-close instead. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment7: autoSwapTargetToken: which currency the post-close auto-swap converts leftover base token into ('SOL' or 'USDC'). Independent of solMode (which only affects how PnL/values are *reported* in Telegram) — this controls what Jupiter actually swaps to on-chain. Toggleable live via the Telegram bot's Settings button.
_comment3: Global auto-exit kill-switch. Also toggleable live via Telegram /pause /resume — this is just the on-disk default.
